label: Family with kids
description: Feeding multiple people (incl. kids), so higher calorie target, balanced macros, no diet restrictions. Pantry leans toward versatile, kid-friendly ingredients. Used as the 'neutral / loose constraints' reference persona.
taste_seeds_notes: Eight popular weeknight comfort dishes (500-720 kcal, 250+ raters each). Examples: crock-pot chicken with black beans & cream cheese, creamy cajun chicken pasta, jo mama's world famous spaghetti, creamy burrito casserole, chicken pot pie, sour cream chicken enchiladas, chicken crescent roll casserole, classic lasagna.
